Name: Monster Slayer Anywhere
Author: AcidicNic
Description:
[size=6][b]Monster Slayer Anywhere[/b][/size][size=3]
﻿View your Monster Eradication Goal List anywhere

[/size][size=5][b]Usage
[/b][/size][size=3][b]F7 [/b]is the[b] default key[/b] to open & close the Monster Eradication Goal List.

[/size][b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/size]
[*][size=3]Extract the zip file into your Mods fol[/size][size=3]der. ([size=3]StardewValley/Mods/[/size])[/size]
[/list][size=5][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (Recommended)[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿﻿﻿ from NexusMods[/size]
[*][size=3]Access mod settings from the title screen ([url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/GenericModConfigMenu/docs/screenshot-title.png]via the cog button[/url]﻿﻿﻿) or in-game ([url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/GenericModConfigMenu/docs/screenshot-in-game-options.png]"Mod Options" button at the bottom of the in-game options menu[/url]﻿﻿).[/size]
[/list][size=5][b]Manual Config[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]A file called `config.json` will generate inside of `Mods/MonsterSlayerAnywhere/` after installing the mod and running the game once.[/size]
[*][size=3]Open `config.json` and change `ToggleMonsterList` to your desired key(s).[/size]
[*][size=3]Here's a [url=https://stardewcommunitywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings#Keyboard]list of keybind values[/url]﻿﻿﻿, for your keyboard or controller.[/size]
[/list][b][size=4]ChangeLog[/size][/b][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][size=2][b][b]1.1.0[/b]
[/b]    + Keybind now toggles the monster eradication goal list, instead of only opening it.
    + Multi-key binding added.[b][b]
[/b]
1.0.0[/b]
    + Added a keybind that opens the monster eradication goal list.
    + Generic Mod Config Menu is supported.[b]
